caption.en: Multi-head attention as a reshape flow. Reshape first, then transpose; heads become a batch-like axis, and the merge is the exact inverse before W_O.
caption.fr: L'attention multi-têtes comme flux de remises en forme. D'abord reshape, ensuite transpose ; les têtes deviennent un axe de type lot et la fusion est l'inverse exact avant W_O.

code.en:
flowchart LR X["X (B,T,d)"] --> P["W_Q, W_K, W_V
each (d,d)"] P --> QKV["Q, K, V
(B,T,d)"] QKV --> RS["reshape
(B,T,h,d_h)"] RS --> TR["transpose
(B,h,T,d_h)"] TR --> AT["per head: scores (B,h,T,T)
+ mask, softmax, x V"] AT --> OH["(B,h,T,d_h)"] OH --> TB["transpose
(B,T,h,d_h)"] TB --> MG["reshape merge
(B,T,d)"] MG --> WO["W_O (d,d)"] WO --> Y["out (B,T,d)"]
code.fr:
flowchart LR X["X (B,T,d)"] --> P["W_Q, W_K, W_V
chacune (d,d)"] P --> QKV["Q, K, V
(B,T,d)"] QKV --> RS["reshape
(B,T,h,d_h)"] RS --> TR["transpose
(B,h,T,d_h)"] TR --> AT["par tête : scores (B,h,T,T)
+ masque, softmax, x V"] AT --> OH["(B,h,T,d_h)"] OH --> TB["transpose
(B,T,h,d_h)"] TB --> MG["reshape de fusion
(B,T,d)"] MG --> WO["W_O (d,d)"] WO --> Y["sortie (B,T,d)"]

caption.en: Heads as subspaces for d = 768, h = 12 (d_h = 64): each head reads its own slice of the projected columns; heads meet only in W_O.
caption.fr: Les têtes comme sous-espaces pour d = 768, h = 12 (d_h = 64) : chaque tête lit sa propre tranche de colonnes projetées ; les têtes ne se rencontrent que dans W_O.

caption.en: The causal mask for T = 4. Query i (vertical) may attend to key j (horizontal) only when j <= i (green: M = 0); the red points above the diagonal get M = -infinity and a softmax weight of exactly 0.
caption.fr: Le masque causal pour T = 4. La requête i (verticale) ne peut regarder la clé j (horizontale) que si j <= i (vert : M = 0) ; les points rouges au-dessus de la diagonale reçoivent M = -infini et un poids softmax exactement nul.

caption.en: Masks are added to the scores before the softmax; causal (T,T) and padding (B,1,1,T) masks broadcast over batch and heads. A row with every key masked gives 0/0 = NaN.
caption.fr: Les masques s'ajoutent aux scores avant le softmax ; les masques causal (T,T) et de remplissage (B,1,1,T) se diffusent sur le lot et les têtes. Une ligne dont toutes les clés sont masquées donne 0/0 = NaN.

code.en:
flowchart LR S["scores S
(B,h,T,T)"] --> ADD(("+")) C["causal M (T,T)
-inf where j > i"] --> ADD PD["padding M (B,1,1,T)
-inf at pad keys"] --> ADD ADD --> SM["softmax per row
exp(-inf) = 0"] SM --> A["weights A (B,h,T,T)
rows sum to 1"] SM -.-> NAN["every key masked in a row
0/0 = NaN"]

flowchart LR S["scores S
